prUrl.description: Full https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/pull/<n> URL of the PR under review. Required, and required in exactly that shape: PrWatcher polls a readonly review step by this URL alone (it has no branch to discover one from) and tests it against an anchored regex, so a trailing /files or /commits, a query string, or a bare number means the step is never polled and never woken.

until.description: 'approved' resolves the step once the verdict is submitted. 'closed' keeps the step open after the verdict, waiting on pr-state until the PR merges or closes — for deployment PRs where the step is the live handle on the PR.

goal.description: What the reviewer is being asked to establish, when it is narrower than a general review.
